capabilities.required_behavior: Parse <=1MiB ordinary JSON, depth64, decoded-key uniqueness, scalar UTF8/surrogates, full i64 and finite fractional numbers including underflow in unused fields.
capabilities.my_api: std_text::read; std_json parser; std_json_view typed nodes, cursors, required/default/bounds/allowed-field helpers
capabilities.notes: General frozen runtime parser is allowed; application schemas remain application work. std_format bounded conversion is not a transport substitute.

capabilities.required_behavior: Encode valid JSON reports containing nested collections, ASCII IDs and integer extrema, up to existing output envelope.
capabilities.notes: Streaming fixed report punctuation remains application structure; reusable JSON construction exists. IDs validated ASCII, so raw ID bytes need no escaping; large outputs must not be silently capacity-reduced.

capabilities.required_behavior: Bounded variable-length lists, key lookup, membership, duplicate counting and tuple-equivalent identities.
capabilities.notes: Inputs IDs<=32 bytes, composite identifiers<=65; generic unknown JSON keys may exceed256 but parser duplicate-key validation does not use fixed-size std_hash_bytes.

capabilities.required_behavior: O(n log n) sorting of up to16384 entries with document-dependent comparator; deterministic lexicographic IDs and pair identities.
capabilities.my_api: std_order descriptors; std_collections::sort_by/lower_bound_by with explicit readonly document context
capabilities.notes: Both mechanisms use bounded O(n log n) heapsort. Callback contexts are synchronous readonly loans, no escaping reference result. Planner uses direct node IDs and shared comparator.

capabilities.required_behavior: Min-priority ready queue with interleaved insertion/removal.
capabilities.notes: Application decides deterministic job priorities; library owns heap mechanism.

capabilities.required_behavior: Track dependencies, ready nodes, completed nodes and remaining/cycle-blocked nodes.

comparators.python: graphlib.TopologicalSorter (available; existing baseline uses bespoke graph algorithm)
comparators.zig: Application algorithm built over std containers

capabilities.notes: Python availability inspected despite baseline not importing graphlib. Application-specific priority, timing, layers and policy are not stdlib work.

capabilities.required_behavior: Byte character-class matching with separate first/rest classes and lengths; workload requests [a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}.
capabilities.my_api: std_ascii::matches/contains with explicit Class and length bounds
capabilities.notes: General class/length matcher is needed, not EDA/planner identifier rules baked into library. No claim of a full regex engine.

capabilities.required_behavior: Enumerate unordered distinct pairs without duplicates, including n=0/1.
capabilities.notes: Pair iteration is library mechanism; rectangle geometry and violation rules remain application work.

capabilities.required_behavior: Checked exact signed64 application arithmetic; integer range/schema validation, integer decimal output.

comparators.python: int/min/max; math.isfinite for JSON fractional validation

capabilities.my_api: compiler integer operations; std_text::number; std_math; std_json transport; std_math::min/max/min_or/max_or<T:integer>
capabilities.notes: No fractional payload computation or shortest-roundtrip float output in v1 workload. Preserve large exponent/underflow transport checks. Generic integer extrema and empty-only defaults now explicit andtested; maximumlaggedpath255000000 fitsi64.

capabilities.required_behavior: Bounded raw stdin read and stdout delivery; no publication after guest failure.
capabilities.notes: No filesystem/network needed by these v1 applications. Buffered output host is trusted, general infrastructure; no schema/domain helpers.

capabilities.required_behavior: Author/run application assertions, public regression cases and independent transport checks.
capabilities.my_api: compiler Boolean/equality expressions and bundled scripts/test_project.py test_ discovery/assertions/filter/skip; common stdlib-only Python application conformance harness; scripts/project.py combines checked source context with declared verification and exclusive per-attempt reports
capabilities.notes: Existing bundled runner supplies isolated source test discovery, structural expectations, filters, skips and diagnostics; common external Python test tooling is allowed to every language. No new compiler-native unittest syntax claimed. Future task guides must expose the permitted tools.
